title: The non-Cohen–Macaulay construction
known: The fibre-product exact sequence and its extra Tor term are checked in this run. The gap is earlier: normality and failure of Cohen–Macaulayness do not alone isolate the bad locus sufficiently for the intended hypersurface choice. Stacks00RD gives the standard finite-type openness context, but does not supply the missing projective input.
residual: A precise example with the intended unusual change in the non-Cohen–Macaulay locus, including every geometric existence choice and local depth calculation.
would_establish: A precise example with the intended unusual change in the non-Cohen–Macaulay locus, including every geometric existence choice and local depth calculation.
first_step: Specify the desired dimension and isolated bad locus on the projective scheme, then find one explicit normal projective example whose local cohomology is computable. A useful first run can finish that example or demonstrate that the proposed dimension pattern is incompatible with the chosen geometry.
rating_qualification: Progress rates a bounded deliverable, not resolution of the broad program.

title: The withdrawn compactness proposition
known: The original linear-variety proof is invalid and the1967 errata expressly withdraw the proposition. The finite-solvability polynomial example checks that proof mechanism only. Successive countable adic lifting has a different argument.
residual: Either a counterexample satisfying the exact hypotheses of withdrawn EGA0.19.3.12, or a corrected theorem with additional countability or topology assumptions.
would_establish: Either a counterexample satisfying the exact hypotheses of withdrawn EGA0.19.3.12, or a corrected theorem with additional countability or topology assumptions.
first_step: Extract the exact original theorem and define its square-open ideals and topology independently of the defective proof. Compare countable versus uncountable inverse systems before attempting a general algebra-lift example. The task should begin from the withdrawal, not by treating the old assertion as established.
rating_qualification: Progress rates a bounded deliverable, not resolution of the broad program.

title: Lang’s alleged gap
known: Jouanolou points specifically to separability of a completion fraction field. Nagata’s1957 note removes a normic-form assumption in related C_i results, which is not enough to identify this analytic gap. The original Lang proof has not been read in this run.
residual: The exact missing step alleged in Jouanolou’s1963 offprint and whether Lang’s own argument or later corrections already handle it.
would_establish: The exact missing step alleged in Jouanolou’s1963 offprint and whether Lang’s own argument or later corrections already handle it.
first_step: Obtain the original1952 paper, locate the convergent-series/complete-valued-field argument, and trace every use of separability. Report a proof comparison with exact pages, even if the outcome is that Jouanolou’s allegation cannot be confirmed.
rating_qualification: Progress rates a bounded deliverable, not resolution of the broad program.

title: Differential-field and discriminant collation
known: The field counterexamples and coefficient-degree formula have been checked. Binary forms and quadrics fail to expose the exponent error; a plane cubic does expose it. The correct differential-field example must actually adjoin the extra independent generator.
residual: An accurate comparison of the manuscript’s characteristic-two examples with the misprinted EGA field, and of the discriminant exponent with the general homogeneous formula.
would_establish: An accurate comparison of the manuscript’s characteristic-two examples with the misprinted EGA field, and of the discriminant exponent with the general homogeneous formula.
first_step: Inspect the exponents and generator lists on the scans, keeping original print and manuscript as separate witnesses. The finished task should provide a short critical note with exact hypotheses and the already saved certificates, not overwrite the diplomatic text.
rating_qualification: Progress is for one bounded run. Any ink collation requires the missing scans; current numeric rating includes that access limit.
